'''Aidan Vurt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served as the [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Leontyne Saresh]], a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the Republic's [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A politically cunning man, Vurt crafted a remarkably popular campaign for Saresh that emphasized her history as a self-[[Edusa revolt|liberated]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], and the two were later [[Marriage/Legends|married]]. However, Vurt was [[Death/Legends|killed]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> in [[3642 BBY]]<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] [[Invasion of Taris|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where their wife was leading the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|Republic initiative]] to rebuild the ruined world.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aidan Vurt first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''{{'s}} entry for Leontyne Saresh.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
